title: Doep doedoe Doep
description:
Just changes the voice of villagers to "Döp".

Also reduces the volume of things like netherportal, pistons and lores.

Enderman now has the voice of Strong (Fallout4).

Phantoms says "Ich bin eine Biene".
body:
Just changes the voice of villagers to "Döp".

Also reduces the volume of things like netherportal, pistons and lores.

Enderman now has the voice of Strong (Fallout4).

Phantoms says "Ich bin eine Biene".
